theorem QOU.Hecke.WedderburnDecomp.frobPairing_block_decomp {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} {q : R} {A : Type u} [CommRing R] [Inv R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [HA : HeckeAlgebra R n q A] [MT : MarkovTrace n q A] [WD : WedderburnDecomp n q A] (a b : A) :
frobPairing n q a b = ∑ lam ∈ all_parts q A, frobPairing n q (a * pi_lambda q lam) (b * pi_lambda q lam)

theorem QOU.Hecke.WedderburnDecomp.frobPairing_block_orthogonal {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} {q : R} {A : Type u} [CommRing R] [Inv R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [HA : HeckeAlgebra R n q A] [MT : MarkovTrace n q A] [WD : WedderburnDecomp n q A] (lam mu : Partition n) (h : lam ≠ mu) (a b : A) :
frobPairing n q (a * pi_lambda q lam) (b * pi_lambda q mu) = 0

theorem QOU.Hecke.WedderburnDecomp.pi_mul_shift {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} {q : R} {A : Type u} [CommRing R] [Inv R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [HA : HeckeAlgebra R n q A] [MT : MarkovTrace n q A] [WD : WedderburnDecomp n q A] (lam mu : Partition n) (a b : A) :
a * pi_lambda q lam * (b * pi_lambda q mu) = a * b * (pi_lambda q lam * pi_lambda q mu)

theorem QOU.Hecke.WedderburnDecomp.trace_decomposition {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} {q : R} {A : Type u} [CommRing R] [Inv R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [HA : HeckeAlgebra R n q A] [MT : MarkovTrace n q A] [WD : WedderburnDecomp n q A] (x : A) :
(MarkovTrace.trace n q) x = ∑ lam ∈ all_parts q A, y_lambda q A lam * chi_lambda lam x

theorem QOU.Hecke.WedderburnDecomp.trace_exhaustive {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} {q : R} {A : Type u} [CommRing R] [Inv R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [HA : HeckeAlgebra R n q A] [MT : MarkovTrace n q A] [WD : WedderburnDecomp n q A] (x : A) :
(MarkovTrace.trace n q) x = ∑ lam ∈ all_parts q A, (MarkovTrace.trace n q) (x * pi_lambda q lam)

theorem QOU.Hecke.WedderburnDecomp.pi_mul_pi {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} {q : R} {A : Type u} [CommRing R] [Inv R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [HA : HeckeAlgebra R n q A] [MT : MarkovTrace n q A] [WD : WedderburnDecomp n q A] (lam mu : Partition n) :
pi_lambda q lam * pi_lambda q mu = if lam = mu then pi_lambda q lam else 0

theorem QOU.Hecke.WedderburnDecomp.yLambda_determined {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} {q : R} {A : Type u} [CommRing R] [Inv R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [HA : HeckeAlgebra R n q A] [MT : MarkovTrace n q A] [WD : WedderburnDecomp n q A] (lam : Partition n) :
(MarkovTrace.trace n q) (pi_lambda q lam) = y_lambda q A lam * ↑(blockDim lam)

theorem QOU.Hecke.WedderburnDecomp.chi_lambda_one {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} {q : R} {A : Type u} [CommRing R] [Inv R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [HA : HeckeAlgebra R n q A] [MT : MarkovTrace n q A] [WD : WedderburnDecomp n q A] (lam : Partition n) :
chi_lambda lam 1 = ↑(blockDim lam)

theorem QOU.Hecke.WedderburnDecomp.block_scaling {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} {q : R} {A : Type u} {inst✝ : CommRing R} {inst✝¹ : Inv R} {inst✝² : Ring A} {inst✝³ : Algebra R A} {inst✝⁴ : HeckeAlgebra R n q A} {MT : MarkovTrace n q A} [self : WedderburnDecomp n q A] (x : A) (lam : Partition n) :
